text_block_list.name: Security Guard
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, it's so cold... Well, that makes sense.
Once the Japan Cup is over, the year is practically at an end—

text_block_list.name: Security Guard
text_block_list.text:
...Hm?
I hear a noise... Is it in here?

text_block_list.name: Security Guard
text_block_list.text:
“—Trainer?
Are you in here~... Woah?!”

text_block_list.name: Security Guard
text_block_list.text: I-Its eyes are red...!! M-M-M-Monsterーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer-san.
I've come to pick you up.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Um, about the other day...
Were you all right?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I heard you were working so late
that you gave the security guard a fright...
choice_data_list: Ah... I guess I got a little too focused.

text_block_list.text:
Ever since the Queen Elizabeth II Cup, my mind has been crystal clear even without sleep...
I threw myself completely into preparing for the Japan Cup.
choice_data_list: But thanks to that, I came up with a great plan!
But thanks to that, I was able to come up with a great plan!

text_block_list.text: Strategies to beat Mejiro Ramonu, countermeasures for every possible race development on the day... Countless ideas keep coming to mind even now.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...You seem to be in
good health today."
choice_data_list: Yeah! So light on my feet I feel like I could fly anywhere!
Yeah! Feels like I could fly anywhere!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
You mustn't fly away, please...
Please stay... by my side.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Don't forget your sunglasses.
...Shall we head to Tokyo Racecourse?
I head to the racetrack earlier than anyone else. Partly to avoid the sun as much as possible... and partly so I can talk with her without rushing.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes. There is no problem...
Or rather...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"I feel like... this is the best
I've ever been."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Instinct...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, yes.
We took different paths, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: There is no need to worry.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
As I mentioned earlier...
Right now is when I am in peak condition.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Today, I don't feel like I'll lose to anyone.
—Not even to Ramonu-san.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...I've kept this a secret until now,
but the truth is, the reason I wanted to aim for
the Triple Tiara... was because of that person.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I can't say... in detail.
All I know for sure is that she paved the way for us.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"That is why I ran that path without hesitation...
and was able to dedicate it all to you."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...If I can surpass her,
then I will truly, in every sense..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I can leave my name etched in history
as a Triple Tiara Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
No.
That alone is not enough...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: —To dedicate it to you.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
If I had been all alone...
I surely wouldn't have achieved anything.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
No, even if I had accomplished something...
It likely would have been hidden in someone else's light.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Still, you were the one...
who brought me all the way here.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Please watch.
Burn it into your memory.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
The only thing...
that I can offer to you.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Please—accept this.
My...—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
This year's Japan Cup is insane, isn't it?!
Who would've thought we'd get to see
Triple Tiara Umamusume battle it out...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Something like this will never happen again!
Whoaaa, I wonder which one is stronger!??

Ahead of the clash of the century,
the stands are filled with anticipation and jubilation.
However—

Beneath the surface, quiet words
were being exchanged.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
So you've decided to stake everything.
In that case...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Give me everything you've got...
No. Give me everything all of you have got.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: You're already wrapped in love, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer...
Please wait for me. And then...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: —Please, keep smiling.
